title: Foundations without Fundamentals: Zero-Shot Blind Spots in Time Series FMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.02058v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Despite the success of Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) on broad benchmarks, their ability to internalize basic temporal logic, especially in settings supported by exogenous covariates, remains under-examined. We introduce SimpleTimeBench, a diagnostic univariate and multivariate "unit test" suite for primitives such as monotonic trends, periodic signals and leading indicator covariates, scenarios where near-perfect forecasts should be trivial. Surprisingly, prominent multivariate TSFMs (Chronos-2, Moirai and Toto) frequently produce suboptimal zero-shot forecasts for these inputs. While fine-tuning Chronos-2 improves its behaviour on specific tasks, we show that this adaptation degrades performance on other fundamental patterns rather than enhancing its generalizable foundational capabilities. translated_title: 没有基本功的基础模型：时间序列基础模型中的零样本盲点
translated_abstract: 尽管时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）在广泛的基准测试中取得了成功，但它们内化基本时间逻辑的能力——尤其是在有外生协变量支持的场景下——仍未得到充分研究。我们提出了SimpleTimeBench，这是一套诊断性的单变量和多变量“单元测试”套件，用于测试单调趋势、周期信号和领先指标协变量等基本要素——在这些场景中，近乎完美的预测本应是轻而易举的。令人惊讶的是，知名的多变量TSFMs（Chronos-2、Moirai和Toto）在这些输入上经常产生次优的零样本预测。虽然对Chronos-2进行微调可以改善其在特定任务上的表现，但我们表明这种适应性调整反而会降低其在其他基本模式上的性能，而非增强其可泛化的基础能力。这揭示了预训练规模与基本时间推理之间的差距，表明当前的TSFMs可能缺乏归纳偏置（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出SimpleTimeBench诊断基准，揭示主流时间序列基础模型（Chronos-2、Moirai、Toto）在单调趋势、周期信号等本应轻而易举的基本任务上零样本预测表现不佳，且微调会损害其他基础能力，暴露出预训练规模与基本时间推理能力之间的差距。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SimpleTimeBench, a diagnostic "unit test" suite revealing that prominent time series foundation models (Chronos-2, Moirai, Toto) frequently fail zero-shot on trivial primitives like monotonic trends and periodic signals, and that fine-tuning degrades other fundamental capabilities, exposing a gap between pre-training scale and basic temporal reasoning.
